column1: # LLM Hallucination Rates on Document Summarisation
# Compiled 29 July 2026 by Dr Yuqian Zhang
# Source: Vectara Hughes Hallucination Evaluation Model (HHEM) Leaderboard
#   (github.com/vectara/hallucination-leaderboard).
#   The HHEM benchmark measures "factual inconsistency with source document"
#   (intrinsic hallucination). Models summarise short documents and a
#   specially trained model detects whether the summary contains information
#   not present in the source. Lower rate = fewer hallucinations.
# Values marked "Vectara leaderboard" are from published benchmark snapshots
# (accessed July 2026). Values marked "Estimated from reported trends" are
# projected from the trajectory of published data and may differ from actual
# results on newer benchmark versions. Post-Q3 2025 values should be treated
# as approximate pending updated leaderboard snapshots.
# Important caveat: This benchmark measures a narrow form of hallucination
# (consistency with a provided document). Open-ended generation tasks show
# substantially higher hallucination rates. The numbers are not transferable
# across tasks.
